quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit IR activity record: 2026-0904-034 (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): H1 2026 revenue was about RMB 136.89 hundred million, up about 61.17% year over year, and net profit about RMB 29.23 hundred million, up about 73.72%, driven by structural demand from high-speed switches, AI servers, HPC and smart vehicles plus a better product mix. The Thailand subsidiary moved from ramp-up into scaled operation and turned a single-quarter profit in Q2 2026. H1 2026 FX loss was about RMB 2.76 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue ~RMB 136.89 hundred million (+~61.17% YoY); net profit ~RMB 29.23 hundred million (+~73.72%); FX loss ~RMB 2.76 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit IR activity record: 2026-0904-034 (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): H1 2026 data-communications PCB revenue was about RMB 113.30 hundred million, up about 73.46% year over year, with data-communications PCB gross margin up about 4.60 percentage points on product mix. quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit IR activity record: 2026-0904-034 (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the company is upgrading efficiency at existing plants and planning multiple new-build projects for phased, upgrade-style capacity expansion aimed at data-communications customers' medium- to long-term demand in AI, high-speed data centers and network infrastructure; it is pushing the Thailand base fully into efficient scaled operation. It holds strategic safety stock of key materials and is accelerating diversified and localized material qualification. Management expects that as industry capacity expands and new capacity lands, entry barriers on mature technology platforms will thin and competition may become more homogeneous and intense; the company says it will not chase scale- and price-led expansion and will concentrate resources on high-value core PCBs for data-communications high-end hardware.
